methods.routes: TypeScript AST: ROUTE_DEF static array; parent + child path concatenation matches Nirax; dynamic expressions preserved without executing them
methods.preferences: TypeScript AST: direct property assignments in definePreferences(PREF_DEF)
methods.store: TypeScript AST: direct property assignments in new Pizzax(base, object)
methods.widgets: TypeScript AST: widgets array plus recursively expanded local array spreads; app.component registrations
methods.navbar: TypeScript AST: direct property assignments in reactive(navbarItemDef)
methods.pages: Recursive .vue file walk under pages, excluding test/spec/stories names; classify direct route references without claiming unreferenced files are unreachable

limitations: Static catalogs establish discovery coverage, not runtime behavior, entitlement availability, or native/WebView compatibility.
Routes with identical full paths may represent shell and empty child declarations; both are intentionally retained.
Component expressions preserve login/role-conditional alternatives; runtime feature flags and nested component actions require manual auditing.
Direct property collection does not expand arbitrary object spreads. Current catalog structures are checked to have no such omitted entries.
Preference and store defaults are source expressions, not evaluated values; all unknown future keys must remain preserved by migrations.
A page without a direct route reference may be nested, dynamically loaded, or a helper; it is not classified as unused.
